description: This Java class 'MessageHeadersBuilder' provides a fluent API for constructing immutable MessageHeaders objects, including methods for setting headers like direction, thing ID, subject, timestamp, status code, and feature ID. It also includes validation for mandatory headers and supports initialization from maps and JSON objects.

classes.name: MessageHeadersBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating immutable MessageHeaders objects with a fluent API, supporting header validation and initialization from various sources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder instance with specified message direction, thing ID, and subject.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Initializes a MessageHeadersBuilder from a given headers map or MessageHeaders object, validating mandatory headers.

methods.name: validateMandatoryHeaders
methods.description: Checks that all mandatory headers are present and valid in the provided headers map.

methods.name: featureId
methods.description: Sets the feature ID header for the message.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME content type of the message payload.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for the message.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp header for the message, either as OffsetDateTime or ISO-8601 string.

methods.name: statusCode
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code header for the message.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header, ensuring mandatory headers cannot be removed.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Builds the immutable MessageHeaders object from the current builder state.
